notes.title: V1.3.2043 Update List
notes.content:
[h1]Anti-Air Lock-On[/h1]
●Added anti-air lock-on functionality. Placing the crosshair near an enemy will gradually lock on.
●Locked-on enemies cannot perform dodge maneuvers.
●A weapon's anti-air value affects not only hit rate against airborne units but also lock-on speed.

[h1]Combat HUD[/h1]
●Added a combat HUD, which can be toggled with the H key.
●In Story Mode, this feature will be unlocked in the mid-game.

[h1]Adjustments[/h1]
●Adjusted mech rotation feel — heavier weapons will cause greater latency.
●Flying enemies breaking through City Defense in Defense battles will no longer affect Honor Points gain.
●Mines can now be detonated by explosions, paralysis effects, and certain abilities.
●In Endless Mode, attempting to unlock achievements without Iron Man Mode enabled will trigger a warning.
●Significantly buffed Fusion attachments related to Arc, Ray and Explosive Weapons.
●The Shield destruction device has been renamed and reworked; it can now also destroy mines.
●Slightly reduced early-game difficulty in Cruel Mode.
●Optimized Arc Weapon targeting logic—destroyed enemies will no longer be locked onto.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
●Fixed an issue where Drone weapon parameters displayed incorrectly.
●Fixed a bug where Ray Weapon width became zero after penetration.
●Fixed an issue where recoil reduction was not working.
●Fixed a bug where Dormitory characters could get stuck.
●Fixed incorrect values in enemy detail information.
●Fixed some cases where weapon textures did not load correctly.
●Fixed an issue where overlapping sound effects could become excessively loud.
●Fixed a bug where Arc Weapon decay reduction modules were not working.
●Fixed an issue where damage reset occurred when Arc Weapon bounce count was doubled.
●Fixed an unexpected exclamation mark appearing in the shop UI.
●Fixed an issue where Sneaking Mode could not be properly settled.
●Fixed an issue where bulk Recycle counted multiple items as one.

[h1]MOD Support[/h1]
●Added support for replacing game mode images on the start game screen.
●Added X additional mech throwable slots. Added a tag for Drone-exclusive weapons.
[h3]New Mech Functions[/h3]
●Add X additional mech throwable slots / Increase mech collision radius / Increase energy consumption when jumping / Increase jump distance / Maintain running state.
●Every X seconds, regenerate Y health points / Invincible shield respawns every X seconds / Generate a deflection shield with X health.
●Increase mech flight speed / Add X additional drones / Increase drone orbit distance by X.

The Chinese New Year is coming soon, which means the work of the past year is almost finished. Thank you all for supporting and encouraging us this year. You have helped this game last another year.
In the 15 months since the game was released, we have done 9 major updates, 23 regular updates, and many small patches. The game has become better and better.
This would not have been possible without your help, which includes your feedback, your enthusiasm for creating mods, and the support from crowdfunding players. Thanks to you, this project, which almost ended a year ago, has gone on for another year and still has a long way to go.

notes.title: V1.3 Big Update
notes.content:
[h1]Major Update: Aerial Combat[/h1]
●New flying mechanics added. The flight target range has been increased, and it now has a dodge attribute. However, the player will fall if they encounter Paralysis or Stunned effects.
●15 new enemy types added.
●2 new bosses added.

[h1]Major Update: Infrastructure System Overhaul[/h1]
●Human resources no longer reset daily; instead, they regenerate every day. Only the excess over the limit will be reset daily.
●The Gadget Factory is removed, and a Warehouse is added to increase the human resources cap. The Human Resources Group now regenerates human resources daily.
●A Weapon Workshop is added, selling high-value weapons that already come pre-equipped with Gadgets and Fusion Gadgets.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/3f3012b246386363d5703dcc6aed60014cdd9d25.png[/img]

[h1]Major Update: Recasting System[/h1]
●After the recasting function is unlocked, players can recast items during recycling.
●Recasted items are destroyed and replaced with three alternatives of the same type. This function allows for quickly processing unnecessary Gadgets and weapons.
●Recasting items has wear and tear, which can be reduced by upgrading infrastructure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/81fb2f7f00c628da7bfe14445479ca7d522fe9b8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/f0c457e8ced67b7e550c12f134afbb04d4728916.png[/img]

●AI's accuracy when using ray targeting has been optimized.
●The mech's rotation mechanism has been optimized for smoother controls.
●A new difficulty option has been added to Survival Mode.
●Shoulder mount weapons are now available in Survival Mode.
●Explosions in the Factory no longer deal damage to players.
●A dynamic adjustment function has been added to modify the number of enemies in defensive levels based on player actions.
●Enemy blind spots have been introduced, where staying directly behind enemies reduces their detection efficiency.
●Random furniture/supplies sales events have been added to Story Mode.

[h1]Other Optimizations[/h1]
●Save slots have been expanded to 8, with double-clicking to load saved games.
●Module upgrades can now auto-fill, eliminating the need for manual adjustments.
●Item descriptions now display the highest-tier items.
●Optimized explosion mark graphics and performance.
●Sound effects have been adjusted to fix loud sound and low-volume issues.
●Added some video tutorials.
●Optimized reticle effects.
●Iron Wall is now penetrable, with a Resistance of 200.
●Service Rifle and Submachine Gun derivatives have been adjusted for greater differentiation.
●When new recipes appear, the type of crafting entry is now indicated.
●Adjusted the effect of eating Nutrition Paste.
●The DataRoom now defaults to being empty, with no personnel inside.
●The DataRoom now allows checking of Melee Weapon Fusion Modules, Shoulder Mount Fusion Modules, and Shoulder Mount Enhancement Modules.
●Optimized adaptive sizing for hint UI panels.

●Fixed an error when closing the mod in the character selection UI at the start of the game.

Let players enhance specific enemies in Endless Mode. Increase character loyalty. Let players choose the enemies for the next day. Recruit characters. Call certain previously existing functions.

Check if a specific item exists, whether a specific character is present, if a character is in the dorm, retrieve a character’s loyalty level.

Set the sender of gifts. Items sent by teammates in the game cannot be returned to them.

Effects like rotating the mech when firing, bullet burst firing, limiting the maximum and minimum fire intervals and reload times.

notes.title: Future Plans + Crowdfunding Preview
notes.content:
[h1]Crowdfunding Preview  [/h1]
Dear players, hello!  
After nearly six months of preparation, our [b]warmup [/b]for crowdfunding campaign is finally about to begin its preview phase. We expect to release the detailed plan within a month.
 In short, [b][u]we will be crowdfunding for four character DLCs and one large expansion DLC, through the creation of some merchandise and in-game naming and customization content.   [/u][/b]


[h1]First DLC  [/h1]
As you all know, the first DLC has been released and is available for free play. [b]Our intention was to provide you with a reference, giving you a general idea of what the subsequent DLCs will be like. If this has managed to build your anticipation, we are truly delighted.  [/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747070/DLC/?curator_clanid=42620129 


[h1]Why Crowdfunding  [/h1]
As for why we are choosing to release our subsequent projects through crowdfunding, the reason is quite simple: we are running out of funds. 
To be precise, the budget for the "Iron Cavalry Girl" project was exhausted six months ago. Up to now, the game's sales revenue has barely covered the three-year development cost and is insufficient to cover the additional costs of nearly a year of continuous updates after the release, let alone the many subsequent projects.  
However, on one hand, many players have given us encouragement and support, hoping to continue experiencing the subsequent content; on the other hand, we ourselves still have many ideas that have not been fully realized and many optimizations that have not been perfected. Therefore, we want to try crowdfunding to see if we can continue this project.  
If funding permits, we will continue to realize our subsequent plans, just as we have continuously optimized and updated over the past year.  


[h1]Detailed Crowdfunding Plan  [/h1]
Since our players come from all over the world and in considerable numbers, we will launch crowdfunding  warmup simultaneously on three platforms:  

Mainland China: 
[h3][u][b]——>>[url=https://m.modian.com/idea/6221]MODIAN[/url]<<——[/b][/u][/h3]
Japan:
[h3][u][b]——>>[url=https://ci-en.net/creator/25654]CIEN[/url]<<——[/b][/u][/h3]
Other regions：
[h3][u][b]——>>KickStarter（Preparing）<<——[/b][/u][/h3]

As long as the total amount raised on all platforms reaches the cost of producing the respective DLCs, we will officially start the subsequent projects. 
We will announce all subsequent crowdfunding funds and the expected cost of each DLC to ensure complete transparency throughout the process.

notes.title: 'Cavalry Girls' with new 'Endless Mode' & Steam Workshop now live! + 20% off!
notes.content:
Published by OKJOY and developed by Neutron Star Game Studio, the light Rogue top-down perspective mech-girl shooting game "Cavalry Girls" welcomes the update with the "Endless Mode and Creative Workshop (Gameplay Numerics)." This update introduces the long-awaited "Endless Mode," [u][b]unlocked after reaching day 62 in story mode. [/b][/u]
The game continues its winter sale keeping the game itself 20% off! It lasts for a week and will end on January 11th!
Besides "Endless Mode," the game now features a Steam Workshop, [u][b]currently limited to adjusting weapon/item stats, adding new weapons, accessories, items, and modifying level pacing.[/b][/u] Players can browse and subscribe to mods directly from the workshop interface. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2055050/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/60e737b4e8f29ff5a1b61d6ccfd1b2e8709173db.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Endless Mode[/b][/h1]
In "Endless Mode," players can select any character to start and will face increasingly stronger enemies, having some control over the direction of enemy enhancements. Affection rewards for the chosen character unlock as affection for all characters increases. Players will encounter frequent battles with increasing enemy spawn rates and numbers, presenting unprecedented challenges!
[list]
[*] Players can choose any character to start the Endless Mode with
[*] Makes voice and related Affinity reward for Mary, who is not the protagonist
[*] In Endless Mode
[*] All systems will be opened at the beginning
[*] Enemies in Endless mode will be strengthened with the number of days. Players can choose the direction of enemy strengthen to a certain extent. Enemy strengthen will last for about 150 days, and will not continue to strengthen thereafter
[*] As the number of boss battles increases, the refresh rate and number of enemies will continue to increase until reaching their peak
[*] The Affinity reward for the selected character will be unlocked as the Affinity of all characters increases
[/list]
[h1][b] STEAM Workshop[/b][/h1]
The STEAM Workshop has officially opened, and players can access it within the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/b176b3a18fbabdc56887e2b32adff30192fb823a.png[/img]
you can download mods and activate them within the game
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/ee436348b4919f4a9d77e5e9080732c530dc3f65.png[/img]
If you are interested in making mods, please refer to the relevant documentation:
[h2][u][b]——>>[url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1CKsaV-Sblpc70OgwfWDitQfhWd-0icK-F-CtqyiZ5FU/edit?usp=sharing]MOD Create Center[/url]<<——[/b][/u][/h2]


[h1][b]Weapon Fusion[/b][/h1]
The new version has added a new function: Weapon Fusion.
Almost any weapon can be fused with another weapon (the current version does not support the fusion of melee weapons)
Players can find the entrance to the fusion weapon in the workshop (the plot is open for 44 days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42620129/c87da566b64a71d7e922bd7b6de6d052e7df85d7.png[/img]
After weapon fusion, the weapons used as materials will disappear, and accessories based on material weapon properties will appear to fill the fusion slot of the original weapon
(For example, if we combine kinetic weapons with shotgun weapons, kinetic weapons will have a scattering effect. If we combine ray with high explosive weapons, the ray may trigger an explosion effect. Of course, based on the type of material, the resulting effect will have a certain degree of randomness.)
At present, there are 51 combinations of fusion effects, totaling 189 accessories

[h1][b] DLC trailer[/b][/h1]

notes.title: Adjustments in the new version of Cavalry Girls ｜v0.5.1116
notes.content:
P.S. The adjustments will not interrupt your save progress.
 
Hello, we have received many feedback from players about the game's difficulty recently. After thorough discussions, we realized that there did exist problems in-game difficulty, so we made our adjustments ASAP to bring a more balanced gaming experience. In addition, since the adjustments are made in a short time, so there may still exist some problems. Feel free to contact us if you encounter any issues. Your feedback means a lot to us.
 
[Adjustments on difficulties]
We have set three new difficulty modes: 【Story Mode】, 【Normal Mode】 and 【Hardcore Mode】. The Story Mode and Normal Mode share the same difficulty but with a newly-added function called Control Board, while the Hardcore Mode will be more difficult in operations and controls for new players.
 
The following are adjustments in the Normal Mode:
 
[More types of enemies to choose]
In over half of the DAYs, more types of enemies are added for players to choose. That enables players to change when they are defeated by certain enemies, so as to clear the stage ASAP.
 
[Adjustments on stats]
Most enemies’ unreasonable stats have been lowered, the figures of resistance and weapons’ power in particular.
The unreasonable amount of enemies in most DAYs has also been reduced, DAYs with boss battles in particular.
 
[Adjustments on peripheral operations]
Most types of enemies in 【peripheral operations】 have been removed and its amount has been reduced by half in one stage. But players can still experience the original difficulty in the Hardcore Mode.
 
[Adjustments on budget]
All the concepts of tax increase, 【cost of ammunition】 and 【cost of strategic weapons】in the second half of the game progress have been deleted, except for【repair cost】.
 
[Adjustments on endings]
Judging from the designs of difficulties and the storyline, the hidden ending is closed temporarily in the Normal Mode.
If you have already triggered the hidden storyline before the update, you can still unlock the hidden ending in this playthrough. 


 [Other overall adjustments and optimizations]
1. The limit of responding to Cavalry Girls only once a day has been canceled.
2. More ways of crafting for tower defense and items, such as 【Flare】, have been added.
3. Some moves have been simplified. For example, now the unused 【manpower】 and 【action points】 will be transformed into money directly.
4. All the units can be controlled by AI, except for those in 【peripheral operations】. Also, players can now have more options in AI control.
5. AI has been strengthened, and more orders are added for players to issue.
6. AI’s judge of the scale of melee attack has been optimized.
7. The profits of 【Infrastructure Division】have been increased, and the consumption has been reduced.
8. Most consumptions have been lowered, such as 【removal cost】 and 【shop refresh price】.
9. The visual effects of 【emp】and【melee attack】have been optimized.

 
[Fixed Bugs]
1. The bug that the volume is affected by screen vibration has been fixed.
2. The bug of 【Arc Gun】shinning too bright in some circumstances has been fixed.
3. The bug of error order of 【shoulder-mounted weapons】on command interface has been fixed.
4. The bug of the sudden change of grenades when the place for grenades is not filled up has been fixed.
5. Some error descriptions of upgrade weapons have been corrected. 
6. Some error editing pages of furniture have been corrected.
7. The bug of sudden breakdown when giving weapon gifts on specific DAYs has been fixed.
8. The bug of no instability in enemies' attacks has been fixed.
 
[Future adjustments]
●We will continue to adjust difficulties by listening to your feedback.
●Due to design errors, there may exist repeated content in the second half of the game progress after the adjustments, but we will add more later.
●We will revise, add, and delete some unreasonable plots.
●The test and launch of the workshop are on the agenda.
